verses.text: O foolish Galatians, who did bewitch you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth crucified?

verses.text: This only would I learn from you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

segments.text: This only would I learn from you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now perfected in the flesh?

verses.text: Did ye suffer so many things in vain? if it be indeed in vain.

verses.text: He therefore that supplieth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.

verses.text: Know therefore that they that are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.

verses.text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the gospel beforehand unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all the nations be blessed.

verses.text: So then they that are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

verses.text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one who continueth not in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.

verses.text: Now that no man is justified by the law before God, is evident: for, The righteous shall live by faith;

verses.text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us; for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

verses.text: that upon the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

verses.text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men: Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet when it hath been confirmed, no one maketh it void, or addeth thereto.

verses.text: Now to Abraham were the promises spoken, and to his seed. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

verses.text: Now this I say: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God, the law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, doth not disannul, so as to make the promise of none effect.

verses.text: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise: but God hath granted it to Abraham by promise.

verses.text: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise hath been made; and it was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

verses.text: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could make alive, verily righteousness would have been of the law.

verses.text: But the scripture shut up all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
